svg.title: Mingyun Chae — Founder of TriAstra
svg.desc: Founder of TriAstra. Senior Backend & AI Agent Platform Engineer. Peak of 123 AI agents running at once (omp coding agents and sub-agents plus Aside browser agents) and about 60 on average over the 7 days to October 18, 2026, from 5-minute samples of session logs; open intervals can overstate active execution, and the counts include non-TriAstra work. 776 TriAstra PRs merged in the last 7 days, counted October 18, 2026 at 09:52 UTC using merges since October 11 at 10:00 UTC, all authors including bots. Seven open-source fixes merged upstream, four hackathon first places, and US and Korean patent registrations. Snapshot: October 18, 2026.
